arguments.sql:
WITH delivered AS (
    SELECT o.order_id, o.order_purchase_timestamp, c.customer_unique_id
    FROM main.orders AS o
    LEFT JOIN main.customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
),
payment_counts AS (
    SELECT p.order_id, COUNT(p.payment_value) AS value_count, COUNT(*) AS row_count
    FROM main.order_payments AS p
    GROUP BY p.order_id
),
customer_counts AS (
    SELECT customer_unique_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count
    FROM delivered
    GROUP BY customer_unique_id
)
SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS joined_rows,
    COUNT(DISTINCT d.order_id) AS distinct_orders,
    COUNT(DISTINCT d.customer_unique_id) AS distinct_customers,
    SUM(d.customer_unique_id IS NULL) AS missing_customer_ids,
    SUM(JULIANDAY(d.order_purchase_timestamp) IS NULL) AS invalid_purchase_timestamps,
    MAX(d.order_purchase_timestamp) AS latest_purchase_timestamp,
    SUM(p.order_id IS NULL) AS orders_without_payments,
    SUM(p.row_count <> p.value_count) AS orders_with_null_payments,
    SUM(p.row_count > 1) AS orders_with_multiple_payments,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer_counts WHERE order_count = 1) AS single_order_customers
FROM delivered AS d
LEFT JOIN payment_counts AS p ON p.order_id = d.order_id

WITH item_amounts AS (
    SELECT i.order_id, SUM(i.price) AS merchandise, SUM(i.price + i.freight_value) AS with_freight
    FROM main.order_items AS i
    GROUP BY i.order_id
),
payment_amounts AS (
    SELECT p.order_id, SUM(p.payment_value) AS paid
    FROM main.order_payments AS p
    GROUP BY p.order_id
)
SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS delivered_orders,
    SUM(i.order_id IS NULL) AS missing_item_orders,
    SUM(p.order_id IS NULL AND i.order_id IS NOT NULL) AS orders_with_items_but_no_payment,
    SUM(p.order_id IS NULL AND i.order_id IS NULL) AS orders_with_neither,
    SUM(CASE WHEN p.order_id IS NULL THEN i.with_freight END) AS item_amount_on_orders_without_payment,
    SUM(ABS(p.paid - i.with_freight) > 0.005) AS orders_where_paid_differs_from_items_with_freight,
    SUM(p.paid) AS sum_payments,
    SUM(i.merchandise) AS sum_item_prices,
    SUM(i.with_freight) AS sum_items_with_freight
FROM main.orders AS o
LEFT JOIN item_amounts AS i ON i.order_id = o.order_id
LEFT JOIN payment_amounts AS p ON p.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
LIMIT -1

arguments.sql:
WITH delivered_orders AS (
    SELECT o.order_id, c.customer_unique_id, o.order_purchase_timestamp
    FROM main.orders AS o
    JOIN main.customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
),
order_spend AS (
    SELECT p.order_id, SUM(p.payment_value) AS amount_paid
    FROM main.order_payments AS p
    GROUP BY p.order_id
),
customer_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        d.customer_unique_id,
        -- Recency is elapsed days from the customer's latest delivered-order
        -- purchase timestamp to the latest such timestamp in the dataset.
        JULIANDAY(MAX(MAX(d.order_purchase_timestamp)) OVER ())
            - JULIANDAY(MAX(d.order_purchase_timestamp)) AS recency_days,
        COUNT(*) AS order_count,
        -- Keep spend unknown when any delivered order lacks a recorded payment.
        CASE WHEN COUNT(p.amount_paid) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(p.amount_paid) END AS total_spend
    FROM delivered_orders AS d
    LEFT JOIN order_spend AS p ON p.order_id = d.order_id
    GROUP BY d.customer_unique_id
),
recency_frequency_percentiles AS (
    SELECT
        customer_metrics.*,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY recency_days ASC) AS recency_pct,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY order_count DESC) AS frequency_pct
    FROM customer_metrics
),
monetary_percentiles AS (
    SELECT
        customer_unique_id,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY total_spend DESC) AS monetary_pct
    FROM customer_metrics
    WHERE total_spend IS NOT NULL
),
scores AS (
    -- Each percentile is the share of customers ranked at least as well.
    -- The 20%, 40%, 60%, and 80% cutoffs give scores 1 to 5 and preserve ties.
    SELECT
        rf.customer_unique_id,
        rf.order_count,
        rf.total_spend,
        1 + (rf.recency_pct > 0.20) + (rf.recency_pct > 0.40)
            + (rf.recency_pct > 0.60) + (rf.recency_pct > 0.80) AS r_score,
        1 + (rf.frequency_pct > 0.20) + (rf.frequency_pct > 0.40)
            + (rf.frequency_pct > 0.60) + (rf.frequency_pct > 0.80) AS f_score,
        1 + (m.monetary_pct > 0.20) + (m.monetary_pct > 0.40)
            + (m.monetary_pct > 0.60) + (m.monetary_pct > 0.80) AS m_score
    FROM recency_frequency_percentiles AS rf
    LEFT JOIN monetary_percentiles AS m USING (customer_unique_id)
),
segment_inputs AS (
    SELECT customer_unique_id, order_count, total_spend, r_score, f_score + m_score AS fm_score
    FROM scores
),
segmented AS (
    SELECT
        customer_unique_id,
        order_count,
        total_spend,
        CASE
            WHEN r_score = 1 AND fm_score BETWEEN 1 AND 4 THEN 'Champions'
            WHEN r_score IN (4, 5) AND fm_score BETWEEN 1 AND 2 THEN 'Can''t Lose Them'
            WHEN r_score IN (4, 5) AND fm_score BETWEEN 3 AND 6 THEN 'Hibernating'
            WHEN r_score IN (4, 5) AND fm_score BETWEEN 7 AND 10 THEN 'Lost'
            WHEN r_score IN (2, 3) AND fm_score BETWEEN 1 AND 4 THEN 'Loyal Customers'
            WHEN r_score = 3 AND fm_score BETWEEN 5 AND 6 THEN 'Needs Attention'
            WHEN r_score = 1 AND fm_score BETWEEN 7 AND 8 THEN 'Recent Users'
            WHEN (r_score = 1 AND fm_score BETWEEN 5 AND 6)
              OR (r_score = 2 AND fm_score BETWEEN 5 AND 8) THEN 'Potential Loyalists'
            WHEN r_score = 1 AND fm_score BETWEEN 9 AND 10 THEN 'Price Sensitive'
            WHEN r_score = 2 AND fm_score BETWEEN 9 AND 10 THEN 'Promising'
            WHEN r_score = 3 AND fm_score BETWEEN 7 AND 10 THEN 'About to Sleep'
        END AS rfm_segment
    FROM segment_inputs
)
SELECT
    rfm_segment,
    COUNT(*) AS customers,
    SUM(order_count) AS delivered_orders,
    SUM(total_spend) * 1.0 / SUM(order_count) AS segment_average_sales_per_order
FROM segmented
GROUP BY rfm_segment
ORDER BY segment_average_sales_per_order DESC, rfm_segment
LIMIT -1

        COUNT(*) AS order_count,

            + (m.monetary_pct > 0.60) + (m.monetary_pct > 0.80) AS m_score

LIMIT 20
